info.name: Forms → Deck
info.summary: Create a Deck card for every Forms submission
info.description:
**Turn form submissions into Deck cards.**
When someone submits a Nextcloud Form, this app creates a card in a Deck board/list you chose, with the answers in the card description. Each user configures their own mappings in **Settings → Personal → Forms → Deck**, so the card is created as *that* user and the normal Deck and Forms permissions apply.
- One mapping = one form → one board + list, with a card title composed from the submission date and/or several question answers (e.g. `28/9/26 - H10 - Top floor ceiling light broken`). - Map the answers of a choice question to the board's existing Deck tags. - Optionally attach the files uploaded through a file question to the card. - Works for logged-in submissions and for public (anonymous) form links. - Re-submitting/editing a submission does not create a second card. - If the configured user loses access to the form or the board, the mapping disables itself and records the reason, and the submission still succeeds.
**Requirements:** the **Forms** and **Deck** apps must be installed and enabled. There is no way to declare another app as a dependency, so this app stays inert (the pickers show empty lists) until both are present.
**Privacy note:** the answers are copied onto the Deck board, so everybody with access to that board can read the form answers.
